expected_diagnosis: Container DNS resolution fails while host resolver succeeds.
recommended_next_checks: docker inspect network settings; /etc/resolv.conf in container.
resolution_guidance: Repair Docker resolver/network settings after cause verified.
verification: Container resolves approved domain and app works.
escalate_when: Docker engine or upstream DNS issue.
production_warning: Không áp dụng lệnh chỉnh sửa trên VPS khách hàng khi chưa có quyền, backup và kế hoạch rollback.
